notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers creating, updating, versioning and aliasing Lambda functions with the AWS CLI, Python handler samples, layers, event source mappings (SQS, DynamoDB Streams, S3, EventBridge), function URLs, concurrency/SnapStart tuning, a SAM template and SAM CLI commands.

Medium: following it has the agent deploy and reconfigure Lambda functions, add resource-based invoke permissions, change S3 bucket notifications, pip-install dependencies into a layer directory and run `sam deploy`, all with the user's configured AWS credentials. Acceptable because these are standard deployment steps for the user's own serverless app and the skill contains no delete/destroy commands.

Review before applying: the function URL example (SKILL.md:239-256) creates a public endpoint with `--auth-type NONE` and `--principal "*"`, so only use it for intentionally public handlers; `put-bucket-notification-configuration` replaces any existing notification config on the bucket. Account IDs and ARNs (123456789012) are placeholders. Related Skills (SKILL.md:408-412) link to sibling skills ../aws-iam/, ../terraform-aws/, ../aws-s3/, ../aws-vpc/, ../aws-cost-optimization/ as optional reading only.
